content.text: I found the concrete leak: several tests run `--batch-mode … animate --saveframes <tmp_path>`. Batch mode silently forces `save=True`, so the renderer writes the requested PNG frames and also compiles an unrequested default `pgkyl.gif` in the process working directory. I’m going to fix that policy so an explicit `--saveframes` destination suppresses the automatic movie save, while preserving deliberate `--save --saveframes` behavior in the Python/render API.
